style.register: 游戏指南体，简体中文，简洁直陈，不用敬语，不用『您』。
style.numbers: 数字、百分比、游戏内数值原样保留（如 10%、+5%）。
style.placeholders: ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ 等占位符必须原样保留且不得增删、不得调换顺序；它们代表图标或链接。
style.markup: 不要输出 HTML 标签；保留原文的换行与项目符号结构。
style.properNouns: 国家、人物、舰名等专有名词使用通用中文译名（如 German Reich → 德意志国，Adolf Hitler → 阿道夫·希特勒）；Paradox 未汉化的专有名词可保留英文并加中文注释。
style.consistency: 同一英文术语在全站必须使用同一译名。

In Finland balance of power there are only 2 sides: ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧.

Public Trust is related to the current country leader of Finland. While the effects of Trust itself are always the same, the lower the Trust, the cheaper it will be to retrire the current country leader. Every leader has a personal agenda which will influence whether trust rises or sinks, depending on the players actions. Finland starts with "Pehr Evind Svinhufvud", who will be replaced by "Kyösti Kallio", who will be suceeded by "Rysto Ryti" and finally by "Juho Kusti Paasikivi". If Finland ever finds itself at war with a major power, they can put "Carl G. Mannerheim" in charge.
